assessment.nobel_worthiness: WMAP made precision cosmology an observational science and established a detailed empirical account of the early universe.
assessment.attribution: The listed leaders represent the mission, its scientific interpretation, and its crucial measurements.
assessment.maturity: Its results have been extensively tested and remain foundational to modern cosmology.
uncertainties: The division of credit within a large satellite collaboration necessarily compresses many essential contributors.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: IceCube opened a genuinely new observational window on the high-energy universe through astrophysical neutrinos.
assessment.attribution: Halzen is the clear listed scientific leader associated with creating and sustaining IceCube.
assessment.maturity: The signal and the field it initiated are established through a substantial body of observations.
uncertainties: The discovery depended on a very large collaboration, making individual attribution intrinsically incomplete.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: BAO supplied a robust standard ruler and transformed observational tests of cosmic expansion and dark energy.
assessment.attribution: Sunyaev represents the early physical insight, while Eisenstein and Percival represent decisive observational establishment and exploitation.
assessment.maturity: Independent surveys have repeatedly confirmed the method and made it central to precision cosmology.
uncertainties: The relevant theoretical and survey contributions extend beyond three individuals.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The prediction and observation of kilonovae provided compelling evidence for neutron-star merger physics and heavy-element production.
assessment.attribution: The proposed theorists and observer capture the unusually direct link between prediction and observational identification.
assessment.maturity: The 2017 multi-messenger event has made the phenomenon a secure part of astrophysics.
uncertainties: The interpretation rests heavily on a landmark event, though subsequent work supports it.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The measurement of theta-13 completed a crucial part of neutrino mixing and made experimental searches for leptonic CP violation realistic.
assessment.attribution: The listed leaders appropriately represent the complementary reactor experiments behind the result.
assessment.maturity: The disappearance measurement has been independently confirmed and incorporated into the standard neutrino picture.
uncertainties: As with other collaboration-scale discoveries, individual credit cannot encompass the full experimental achievement.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Inflation and the quantum origin of structure are among the most consequential ideas for understanding the observable universe.
assessment.attribution: The three proposed names represent the inflationary mechanism, its development, and the account of primordial fluctuations.
assessment.maturity: Its broad observational successes are impressive and enduring.
uncertainties: No direct observational signature uniquely selecting inflation or a particular inflationary model has yet been established.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Geometric phase and the Aharonov-Bohm effect exposed a deep physical role of phase and gauge structure, with wide consequences across physics.
assessment.attribution: Berry and Aharonov are the unmistakable names attached to the two central phenomena in this citation.
assessment.maturity: Both effects are experimentally secure and conceptually productive over decades.
uncertainties: Combining two distinct discoveries in one citation complicates a single historical attribution.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Optical lattice clocks have achieved a decisive advance in timekeeping and enable new tests of gravity and fundamental physics.
assessment.attribution: Katori and Ye are the clearly identified pioneers of the concept and its realization.
assessment.maturity: The technology is repeatedly demonstrated at extraordinary precision and is already scientifically enabling.
uncertainties: Its ultimate scientific impact beyond metrology is still developing.
